Udayan Biswas Biswas bhavan, South Bireshpally, P.S. Madhyamgram, Kolkata, West Bengal – 700129 Contact: +91-7980134336; Email: udayanb90@gmail.com; Date of Birth: 26th March, 1997

Network Security Engineer Seeking challenging assignments with esteemed organization

PROFILE

Offering rich cross-functional experience on Network Infrastructure maintenance, support and implementation; currently spearheading as Network Security Engineer at Cognizant.

Proven competencies at all phases of Maintenance and Implementation Life Cycle, which includes Requirement, Estimation, Design, Analysis, Testing, Implementation and Support.

Analytical thinker, consistently resolving ongoing issues, often called upon to consult on problems that have eluded resolution by others.

A systematic, organized, hardworking and dedicated team player with leadership qualities with an analytical bent of mind, determined to be a part of a growth-oriented organization.

Technical Skills

CISCO Switching & Routing Panorama Zabbix SNMP Monitoring Session persistence F5 LB

BIG IP F5 LTM & APM Cisco Nexus 9Ks Grafana dashboard SSL Offloading F5 LB

Palo Alto Firewall Cisco ASA & FTD IPSEC VPN Tunnel Zscaler ZIA, ZPA

FortiClient VPN solution VMware NSX-V Routing protocol: BGP, OSPF Riverbed WAN optimizer

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE (Total 6.5 Years) Cognizant Technology Solutions Network Security Engineer   Hands-on experience on switching, routing and security of an entire network infrastructure on a global scale comprising

(Since February’2025)

Spearheading efforts as Network security engineer for the entire infrastructure of CTS.



of 1500+ firewalls. Implementation and maintenance of firewalls comprising of leading vendors like Palo Alto, Cisco FTD, Cisco ASA and VMware NSX.

Expertise in troubleshooting techniques comprising of hands-on experience in NAT, Route and ACLs for different leading firewall vendors.

Worked on creating session persistence for multiple global production URLs using Cookie, source/destination, hash- based persistence profile in F5 LB.

Worked on SSL Offloading for many servers at F5 Load balancers by deploying the requisite certificates at the LB end.  Worked on active health monitoring of servers present in F5 LB using HTTP. Leveraged this functionality to re-direct traffic to other nodes if one is not responding to the health monitors in specific timeout period.

Worked on CyberArk onboarding of 1500+ devices by deploying correct route, NAT and ACL.  Worked on DNAC onboarding of 1500+ devices by deploying correct route, NAT and ACL  Worked on troubleshooting entire network path comprising of different switches, firewalls and cloud infra for application deployment.

TATA CONSULTANCY SERVICES Network Security Engineer

(Since January’2020)

Contributed as Network engineer for one of major publishing company globally.  Gained good experience on switching, routing and security of an entire network infrastructure on a global scale.  Maintenance of SDWAN for all the global site (Vendor driven).   Implementation and maintenance of BIG IP F5 load balancers and BIG IP F5 APM, Site to Site VPN tunnel with Palo Alto. Implementation, maintenance and overall ownership of Palo alto devices for network security including implementing rules, whitelisting or blocking of websites based on SOC recommendation.

Timely patching of all network related devices in (N-1) level. Devices: Meraki, Palo alto FW, Riverbed, Cisco Nexus 9Ks, F5 BIG IP LTM & APM.

Bandwidth report generation of all global sites as per 95 percentile formats.  Efficiently handled successful analysis, continuation, designing, delivery & resolution of number of major incidents. Exploring RCA of major incidents and implementing workarounds.

Managing Coordination with upstream - downstream projects for implementing changes impacting/involving multiple teams.

Created Tutorial videos for interactive dashboards in Grafana platform.

B.Tech. (Electrical Engineering), 2018  DGPA 8.43 Class 12, 2014  KVS, Kolkata; 69.8 %, Class 10, 2012: KVS, 94% Languages Known: English, Hindi and Bengali

Hobbies: Research, Quiz, Exploring repair on RE 350
